title: Apple Slides---and Takes the Dow Down With It
text:
Apple Slides—and Takes the Dow Down With It By Updated Nov. 12, 2018 9:38 a.m. ET Order Reprints Michael Haddad Text size
We take back what we said about a quiet Veterans Day as concerns about demand for Apple (AAPL) iPhone has caused the stock—and the market to appear headed for a lower open. S&P 500 futures have fallen 0.3%, while Dow Jones Industrial Average futures have declined 68 points, or 0.3%, and Nasdaq Composite futures have declined 0.6%.
Here are five stocks in play this morning: Alibaba (BABA) is down 0.5% to $144.16, as its Singles Day Event generated total gross merchandising volume up 27% to $30.8 billion, down from last year’s growth rate of 39%. Altria (MO) is down 4.8% to $60.33 after The Wall Street Journal reported that the Food and Drug Administration may also ban menthol cigarettes . Apple has dropped 2.4% to $199.50 after Lumentum Holdings (LITE) said “one of its largest industrial and consumer customers for laser diodes for 3-D sensing” had cut orders . Lumentum has tumbled 27% to $41.00. Athenahealth (ATHN) is up 8.3% to $130.47 on reports Veritas Capital and Elliott Management plan to bid $5.5 billion for the firm , according to a report from Reuters. Athenahealth also reported third-quarter earnings . The health-care IT provider earned $1.08 a share on revenue of $331.4 million. Analysts were looking for EPS of 99 cents on revenue of $329.5 million. For the full year, it sees revenue of $1.335 billion to $1.365 billion, above the $1.35 billion consensus. Occidental Petroleum (OXY) is up 1.3% to $73.55 after Barclays initiated coverage with an Overweight rating. SAP (SAP) is down 4.6% to $103.03 after saying it will buy Qualtrics for $8 billion in cash .
